visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young man in a black blazer and t-shirt standing in a studio with blurred screens behind him; a news overlay at the top shows rainy streets and traffic in New Taipei City. Yellow text captions appear in the center of the frame. (2) A close-up shot shows raindrops falling onto a dark, rippling water surface, followed by a sequence of map graphics of Taiwan showing specific regions like Keelung with an anthropomorphic sweating emoji overlay. (3) The creator points to the side as a green map of Orchid Island (Lanyu) appears accompanied by a cartoon rain cloud icon and statistics showing 208 rainy days out of 365. (4) A digital screenshot of a mobile search result for Yangmingshan appears, detailing its ranking and data while the creator gestures with his hands in the foreground. (5) The visual shifts to a map of Keelung labeled 'Rain Capital' with a happy rain cloud, followed by a map of Taipei with a sad face as a semi-transparent rain-streaked overlay covers the frame. (6) A woman in a well-lit indoor bedroom smells a pink towel with a look of disgust, transitioning to a product shot of a white, rectangular SHARP dehumidifier unit placed in a minimalist living room. (7) A montage shows the dehumidifier's features, including airflow animations from the top vent, the glowing control panel interface, and a hand pulling out a transparent water collection drawer from the side. (8) The creator returns to the studio setting, presenting map graphics of Penghu, Tainan, and Taichung with bright sun icons to indicate low rainfall, ending with large white query text overlays.
